title: A map from the keyboard
description: Nodes, navigation and rearranging branches without constantly switching to touch.

blocks.text: During a fast sketch even small stops get in the way of holding on to a thought. What is needed is a connected set of controls, not a few random hotkeys.

quote.text: You lack the simple keyboard navigation to expand and condense nodes (or topics), and you lack the keyboard based resizing of the map to zoom in and out with ease.

blocks.text: Think through the commands for creating, navigating, expanding and moving. Show the available actions next to the current selection.
Test on real typing and on editing several branches. Support for an external keyboard should not make ordinary input or stylus control worse.
